summary: Sino Green Land Corp. filed an 8-K (Items 2.01 and 3.02) disclosing completion on November 4, 2026 of its acquisition of 80% of Hi-Quality Productions Inc., a New Jersey corporation based in Camden, under a stock purchase agreement with seller Cheng You. The company paid 40% of total consideration: US$216,000 cash plus 840,000 common shares at a fixed US$0.60 per share (US$504,000), aggregating US$720,000. Shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2). The balance of consideration and timing of the remaining 60% is undisclosed; watch dilution and the deferred payment obligation.
